description:
benchbox.dev is served by the Astro build in this repository. The site split copied files that the build no longer uses; none of the legacy pages is served (/script.js, /style.css, /shared/site-header.js and /prompts/prompts.js return 404).

- Delete the unserved static pages and scripts: landing/index.html, landing/script.js, landing/style.css, landing/prompts/index.html, landing/prompts/prompts.js, landing/prompts/catalog.generated.js and landing/prompts/catalog.yaml (the catalog now comes from the bundle's landing/prompt-catalog.json).
- Delete landing/shared/site-header.css, site-header.js and site-theme.js, used only by the deleted pages.
- Retire the second theme file: move the two variables landing/prompts/prompts.css reads from landing/shared/site-theme.css (--bb-site-header-cta-text, --warning-color) into site-tokens.css, then drop site-theme.css and its import in website/src/styles/landing-theme.css.
- Point the explorer/e2e/routes/header.spec.ts static-surface tests (around lines 23-24) at the built / and /prompts/ pages, or delete them in favour of website/tests/shell.test.ts.
- Remove the legacy old-vs-new comparison from website/e2e/landing.mjs (LANDING_DIR / OLD_BASE_URL, around lines 32 and 471).
- Keep files the build imports: landing/shared/site-tokens.css, site-shell.css, landing/prompts/prompts.css, landing/hero.png (they may move to a neutral path, updating explorer/src/index.css, Shell.astro, astro.config.ts and tests). Keep landing/prompts/a11y-checklist.md, which site-browser-acceptance-ci-20261017 updates.
- Remove the Sphinx-era parity data and tools: inventory/baseline-develop/, expected-removals-*.json, added-paths.json, allowed-inventory-losses.json, website/scripts/id-parity.ts and the id-parity script in website/package.json. website/tests/legacy-assets.test.ts also reads inventory/baseline-develop/ (the case that covers every download URL the Sphinx baseline published, around lines 137-147): rewrite that case against inventory/legacy-downloads.json or remove it.
- Remove scripts/shadow-compare.mjs, scripts/shadow-compare.test.mjs, inventory/shadow-allowlist.json, the shadow:compare script in package.json and their AGENTS.md mention.
- Remove inventory files nothing reads (allowed-differences.json, redirect-pages.json, release-known-broken/, api-public-symbols.json) and the .js branch of parseCatalogSource in prompt-catalog.ts that only a test exercises.
- Keep inventory/known-broken-links.json, inventory/api-reference-url-map.json (core docs link to it) and anything the build, deploy or CI still reads.

The MyST converter decision stays with site-myst-converter-retirement-20261017.
